name: forcing-3-uci-confirmation-v1
question: Does loss-derived Forcing-3 improve complete-game strength over the accepted two-ply policy on untouched openings?
candidate: Unchanged Locked-3 formula; all legal roots; forcing/forcing/forcing; tactical-first ordering; stand-pat outside check; 256 internal children per legal root; UCI lexical root ties
opponents: Accepted Searched-3 baseline: forcing/forcing and 128 children per legal root
Stockfish 18 with Threads 1, Hash 16 MB, and 100 nodes per move

openings.pairing: Each opening is played twice per opponent with candidate colors reversed

resources.state_accounting: Legal root moves plus every internally expanded child reported as UCI nodes

metrics: wins, draws, losses, paired score and engine-pool Elo intervals
candidate and opponent move time and reported states/nodes
termination reasons, illegal moves, crashes, null moves, and timeouts
decision: Confirm only if candidate and opponents have zero forfeits and the 95% opening-pair-bootstrap score lower bound against searched-3-baseline is above 50%. Stockfish is an external anchor without a threshold.
guardrail: The loss-derived frontier selected this candidate. Only this new suite can confirm it; do not tune from these games. Engine-pool Elo is not human FIDE Elo.
